title: HostCover Valuables Settlement: Host Acceptance Tool Reference
content:
A valuables claim (art, jewellery or collectibles) that the claims team has approved on a **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)** plan is settled with a valuables settlement. Because the value of such items rests on the host's own appraisals, provenance and receipts, a valuables settlement is booked only when the host accepts it in person, and the figure booked is the valuables settlement on that claim at the moment the host accepts it. Every base condition on paying a claim continues to apply: the claim is approved, it was escalated in time, the stay is covered, and a claim is reimbursed once.

Where the same stay also carries an approved theft claim, the valuables settlement is fixed only after the plan's HostCover ledger shows a reimbursement on that theft claim.

Said the other way round: while the plan's HostCover ledger shows no reimbursement on an approved theft claim of the same stay, the valuables settlement on that stay is not yet fixed.

## Capability

`accept_valuables_settlement_01cb0de3` records the host's acceptance of the settlement offered on an approved valuables claim and books the settlement as a reimbursement entry on the HostCover ledger of the plan the valuables claim was filed under. The entry carries the claim, the stay the loss arose from, the loss the claims team verified, the date of acceptance and the settlement amount accepted. The plan's reimbursements grow by that amount, the claim shows as reimbursed in the HostCover ledger, and the money is credited to the host's default payout method by the payout desk.

## Invocation

This is the host's own tool. The agent unlocks `accept_valuables_settlement_01cb0de3` and hands it over to the host; the customer themselves runs it to accept the settlement.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_id` | the reference number of the host's approved valuables claim, as the support agent reads it to the host from the damage-claim records of the HostCover plan | identifier, as shown in the claim records |
| `amount` | the settlement the host accepts on the claim, exactly as the support agent states it | positive USD amount with 2 decimal places (cents); no currency symbol |

Neither parameter takes a fixed list of values.

## Return

On success the host receives a receipt:

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| `status` | `settlement_accepted` when the acceptance was recorded and the settlement booked |
| `protection_event_id` | the reference number of the new ledger entry |
| `claim_id` | the valuables claim settled |
| `stay_id` | the stay the loss arose from |
| `amount` | the settlement booked in USD, 2 decimal places |
| `posted_date` | the booking date, YYYY-MM-DD |
